task: Open GitHub Copilot's FAQs to find the official answer to when Copilot chat can be used on mobile.
answer: GitHub Copilot chat can be used on mobile via the GitHub Mobile app. The official GitHub Copilot plans page lists the availability row 'GitHub (including github.com and GitHub Mobile)' as Included for Copilot Free, Pro, Pro+, and Max, so it is available whenever you have any Copilot plan. The official GitHub docs also state: 'If you're a member of an organization or enterprise, your access to Copilot Chat in GitHub Mobile may depend on policies set by your administrator.'
